description: This PHP class defines the EmploymentStatus filter field used within the OrangeHRM reporting module. It extends a base FilterField class and implements the ValueXNormalizable interface. The class provides methods to modify database queries based on employment status, retrieve entity aliases, and convert the filter value to an array with employment status details.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: A filter field class for employment status used in report filtering, enabling query filtering and data normalization.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to add a condition for filtering employees by employment status when the operator is EQUAL and a valid value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in the query, here it returns 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the filter value into an array containing the employment status's ID and label if available.
